codeql_limits.note: ram_mb (database creation) raised 12288 -> 20480 on 2026-10-30; analysis_ram_mb 28672 (28 GiB) added on 2026-10-30 after OutOfMemoryError (Java heap) in B2 CodeQL analyses of three NiFi cases. Resource limits only; host has 30 GiB, one process at a time.
codeql_limits.effective_ram_setting: Only an explicit `--ram` is honoured by CodeQL 2.15.5 (default compiler heap -J-Xmx3428M; ~/.config/codeql/config and the CODEQL_RAM env var have no effect, verified in the query-run logs). Since 2026-10-31 the patched neusym_vul.py passes `--ram <analysis_ram_mb>` (26000 -> ~10.7 GB compiler heap) to `codeql database analyze`. Earlier ram_mb values 12288/20480/28672 had no effect.

package_names_regeneration.reason: At cwe-bench-java 698fb72 the package-names files for these two slugs are missing; files named hapifhir__hapi-fhir_<CVE>_<tag>.txt exist but list ca.uhn.fhir.* packages of a different repository (hapifhir/hapi-fhir) and are byte-identical across both versions. They are regenerated with the upstream tool scripts/get_packages_codeql.py after the database is built. The pom groupId (ca.uhn.hapi.fhir) does not prefix the project's source packages, so --internal-package is given explicitly.
